title: Are Latent Reasoning Models Easily Interpretable?
summary: 研究发现，像Coconut和CODI这样的潜在推理模型在逻辑任务中几乎不使用隐藏推理步骤，其高性能主要来自训练数据而非推理过程。但在数学问题上，模型隐藏状态中确实包含正确的中间步骤，可解释性高达93%，且这种可解释性可用于预测答案正确性。
highlights: You can force the models to stop thinking early and they almost always spit out the same response anyway.
when the models got the math problem right the researchers found the correct intermediate math steps in their hidden states up to 93% of the time.
models are actually way more interpretable than the AI community assumed.
you can even use that interpretability as a signal to guess if the model is about to give a right or wrong answer.
